commands.name: Reset Counters

commands.description: Read a single BMS Data ID via I2C. Reply arrives as REPORT_TLM (0x08C7).

commands.description: Read all 12 BMS Data IDs (0x01~0x0C) in sequence.

commands.description: Apply (PowerOn=1) or remove (PowerOn=0) 3.3V supply to BMS.

commands.description: Software reset. Clears all fault flags and BmsData cache.

commands.description: LGBAT_SEND_HK_MID — SCH wakeup: triggers I2C poll and publishes HK_TLM (0x08C6).

commands.name: Request Beacon
commands.description: LGBAT_SEND_BCN_MID — SCH beacon trigger: causes OBC to emit BCN_TLM (0x08C8).

telemetry.name: HK_TLM
telemetry.description: Housekeeping telemetry. struct fmt ">BBBBBxxxHhHBBBBB" (19 B payload).

telemetry.name: BCN_TLM
telemetry.description: Beacon telemetry. struct fmt covers BMS DataIDs 0x01~0x0C (86 B payload).

telemetry.name: REPORT_TLM
telemetry.description: Command report / response packet. Carries return code and optional data from Request Data (FC=3). struct fmt ">HBBiH" header + up to 512 B return value.

fields.name: OrigMsgID
fields.description: MID of the command that triggered this report

fields.name: CC
fields.description: Function code of the originating command

fields.name: ReturnCode
fields.description: Signed return code from the handler

fields.name: ReturnDataSize
fields.description: Number of valid bytes in ReturnValue (0 if none)

fields.name: ReturnValue
fields.description: Raw return data; valid length = ReturnDataSize
